## PAGE: Methodology
URL: https://www.aitoolcrux.com/methodology
Title: Our Review Methodology | AIToolCrux

We use a six-dimension scoring system for every AI tool:
1. Features (25%): Breadth and depth of functionality
2. Ease of Use (20%): Learning curve and user experience
3. Performance (20%): Speed, accuracy, and reliability
4. Value for Money (15%): Pricing relative to capabilities
5. Support (10%): Customer service and documentation quality
6. Innovation (10%): Unique features and advancement

All tools are tested hands-on by our editorial team. Ratings are updated regularly.
Affiliate relationships do not influence ratings or rankings.

Description: Google's most capable AI model with exceptional Google services integration, a massive 1M token context window, and the best free tier in the industry. Features native real-time search powered by G...

Key Features:
- Gemini 2.5 Pro model with strong general capabilities
- Massive 1M token context window (~750,000 words) - largest among consumer models
- Deep Google integration - Workspace, YouTube, Search, Maps all natively connected
- Native real-time search powered by Google's index - more accurate than competitors
- Multimodal support - text, image, audio, and video input/output
- Built-in Imagen 3 for high-quality image generation
- Best free tier in industry - 50 messages/2hrs with full Pro model, no credit card required
- Gemini Advanced includes 2TB Google One cloud storage

Pros:
- Best free tier - 50 messages every 2 hours with the full Pro model, no credit card required
- Deep Google integration - native Workspace, YouTube, Search, and Maps integration
- Massive 1M token context window - largest among consumer AI models
- Native real-time search powered by Google - more accurate and up-to-date than competitors
- Multimodal support - text, image, audio, and video input with built-in Imagen 3 generation

Cons:
- Lower output quality - doesn't match Claude or ChatGPT in writing or coding quality
- More hallucinations - higher hallucination rate (~12%) than Claude (~6%) or ChatGPT (~9%)
- Inconsistent performance - quality can vary significantly between queries
- Gemini Advanced is overpriced - $20/month for marginal improvements over the excellent free tier
- Privacy concerns - Google's data practices raise privacy questions for some users

Use Cases:
- Google Workspace tasks - Gmail summarization, Docs analysis, Sheets data processing
- YouTube video analysis - summarization, content extraction, Q&A about videos
- Real-time research - powered by Google Search with accurate, up-to-date information
- Student work - homework help, concept explanation, essay writing, study assistance
- Casual use - quick questions, creative ideas, image generation with Imagen 3
